items.item: Win probabilities corrected — one value across every page
items.done_test: six pins at 12.5569 in one commit; two surfaces return the same number for the same game; coverage ~90.2
items.evidence: The win-probability spread is now one number everywhere and the coverage it produces moved from eighty-six to ninety percent. The two public surfaces still draw around different centres, though, and fed one identical centre both agree exactly. Making the centre one number means promoting the successor engine, whose own acceptance test says stop and report.
